findings.claim: The gated verifier-allowlist check on the modified class (classViolations(policy, allowlist, delta.changed, "modified", true)) has no test: every allowlist case in TestCheckPolicyGatedVerifierAllowlist adds a new rule (added class), and TestCheckPolicyGatedChangedMarkerLine edits a protected-scope rule that is flagged by scope before the verifier check is reached. Flipping the changed-class bindsVerifier argument to false keeps the suite green while a branch in a gated repo with an explicit verifier_allowlist can re-point an editable-scope rule (e.g. ACDSL-GOLANG-100 gofmt -> a registry verifier outside the allowlist) without any ACDSL-POLICY diagnostic.
findings.evidence: Re-read policy.go:78-109 (classViolations: bindsVerifier gates the allowlist check after the editable-scope check) and 372-374 (added/modified pass true, removed false). Re-read policy_test.go:201-244: GatedScopes and GatedVerifierAllowlist only append new rule lines; GatedChangedMarkerLine modifies ACDSL-PLAN-100, which exits at the !editable[scope] continue (policy.go:100-103) before line 104. git grep for classViolations/verifier_allowlist in *_test.go finds only policy_test.go:239 (an added-rule case). go test ./internal/acdsl passes at head.
findings.fix: Add a TestCheckPolicyGatedChangedRebindsVerifier case: base policy {"mode":"gated","editable_scopes":["GOLANG"],"verifier_allowlist":["gofmt"]}, base registry with gofmt and other, working rules.acdsl rewrites ACDSL-GOLANG-100 to bind other; assert the message 'rule ACDSL-GOLANG-100 binds verifier "other" outside the sanctioned set'.

findings.claim: writeInstallEnv, the Windows writer of install.env, has no test, so nothing pins its KEY=VALUE output to the reader config.installEnvValues / ExpandInstallMarkers (which looks up PEEK_CONTROL_PORT). Renaming the written key or changing the line format keeps every suite green while a Windows install with -peek-control-port 42542 has {{PEEK_CONTROL_PORT}} expanded to the 42442 default in the fragment comparison.
findings.evidence: Re-read install_windows.go:136-149 (fmt.Sprintf of CONFIGSERVER_PORT/PEEK_PORT/PEEK_CONTROL_PORT lines, net.SplitHostPort error path) and internal/config/installenv.go:18-40 (reader keyed on the literal PEEK_CONTROL_PORT, default 42442 when absent). git grep writeInstallEnv in *_test.go returns nothing; installenv_test.go builds install.env from hand-written strings, never from the writer. The file is //go:build windows, so the test needs a windows-tagged _test.go.
findings.fix: Add cmd/configserver/install_windows_test.go (//go:build windows): writeInstallEnv(t.TempDir(), "127.0.0.1:6002", 4343, 42542), t.Chdir into it, assert config.ExpandInstallMarkers([]byte("{{PEEK_CONTROL_PORT}}")) == "42542" plus an invalid-addr case returning an error.
